invocation_scope: author handoff only; coordinator creates publication worktree, commits, pushes and draft PR

public_suitability.author_run: Structured reports, source snapshots, manifests and author-only scripts; bounded credential-pattern inspection found no hits; local absolute paths are provenance
public_suitability.excluded_private_material: No credentials, raw client conversations, .devforge-runtime contents, global provider profiles or authentication stores read/copied/inventoried
public_suitability.limits: Not a guarantee against all secrets. External archives and newly exposed Git history require coordinator exact-content publication review. A path/hash inventory is not a backup.
public_suitability.source: Read-only publication-content inspection of all 184 regular UTF-8 source files (122475 bytes): no symlinks, binaries, conventional credential signatures, raw conversation stores, personal filesystem/email locators or obvious private client state. Synthetic secret fixture is harmless test content. This is not native behavior evaluation.

publication_preservation.complete_author_receipt_closure: 184 current source files plus all original run files are inventoried. Keep original paths as historical locators and use a separate mapping when relocating; do not rewrite frozen records.
publication_preservation.external_review_dependencies: Review summaries/receipts and selected raw diagnostics are inventoried. Full external review archives remain local under their original roots; recursively preserve needed referenced snapshots before claiming portable/review receipt completeness. Their full archival replication is coordinator-owned.
publication_preservation.local_only_remainder: All original .poc author/review/preparation records remain local until coordinator preservation. Reproduced fixture staging is reproducible but retained because old receipt includes it. Private operational state remains outside this public-source handoff; no off-machine backup is claimed.
publication_preservation.parked_preparation: Full native preparation packet remains with integration owner, outside this source release; HANDOFF is recorded for status only. Do not launch it.
publication_preservation.required_action: Coordinator preserves selected public-safe evidence bytes and their reference closure with old-path/new-path/hash mapping; proposed durable paths are not claims of existing copies

release.meaning: Copy/publication permission for these recorded bytes only; not release of worktree/assignment ownership, source cleanup, native qualification or human acceptance
